**Analysis:**

Both years are reported on the same fiscal-year basis (year ended June 30) and same accounting basis (GAAP, per the same 10-K), so the comparison is directly comparable.

- FY2024: Revenue $245,122M, Cost of revenue $74,114M → Gross profit = $170,  $245,122M − $74,114M = $171,008M → Gross margin = $171,008M / $245,122M = 69.76% [DOC-1]
- FY2023: Revenue $211,915M, Cost of revenue $65,863M → Gross profit = $211,915M − $65,863M = $146,052M → Gross margin = $146,052M / $211,915M = 68.92% [DOC-1]

Change in gross margin = 69.76% − 68.92% ≈ +0.84 percentage points, indicating an improvement.

ANSWER: Microsoft's gross margin improved from FY2023 to FY2024 by approximately 0.84 percentage points (from ~68.92% to ~69.76%).
